integrity: Proof and standalone numerical checks accompany the result. Scientific originality is qualified by possible implicit derivability from known joint-transform theory; no independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous one-dimensional Poisson restarting, absorbing target, and regularly varying nonnegative displacement costs of index at least zero; Pearson result only in the r downarrow 0 limit. General prior joint Laplace transform is acknowledged. Higher-dimensional, non-Poisson and physical return-time models are not proved.
title: Universal weak-reset cost–search correlation and its sharp linear-growth maximum
